about_the_game:
Starforged Legacy is a sci-fi survivors game where you’ll forge a single starcraft into a fleet-leveling warship through the combination of salvaged weaponry, strategy-defining augmentations, and cleverly assigned crew members. Weave through asteroid fields, aid galactic denizens, and use collected resources from each failed expedition to become permanently stronger! Your goal is survival; your legacy is inevitable.

Features

  • Intense Bullet-Heaven Combat - Obliterate endless swarms of alien and pirate combatants on your journey to challenge the enemy flagship! Evade devastating bombardments with unique movement abilities and return fire automatically or manually.

  • Customizable Ship and Crew - Master 16 ships, each with distinct starting armaments and combat styles. Recruit crew members to your ship for additional bonuses!

  • Weapon and Ship Augmentation - Forge endless builds and discover devastating synergies with 6 core weapons and over 115 augments to empower your arsenal!

  • Chart a Perilous Course - Navigate a galaxy that changes every expedition—traverse sectors with treacherous, gameplay-altering conditions to complete missions that are no less dangerous.

  • Narrative Encounters - Face dynamic encounters where your choices matter! Reap reward or catastrophic consequence for investigating deep-space anomalies, bribing enforcers, or rescuing stranded scientists!

  • Meta Progression - Exchange salvaged resources for permanent enhancements, new starcraft, additional crew members, and more to aid you in future runs!

Master 16 unique starcraft across three classes: nimble frigates, versatile cruisers, and titanic battleships. All ships—through their special augments, weapons, and movement abilities—lend themselves to unique playstyles and combat specializations, such as the agile, radiation-spewing burst-drive “Stormbolt” frigate or the titanic “Dominance” battleship, boasting a micro-warp drive capable of teleporting short distances.

Carefully select your crew of naval officers, engineers, and pilots to receive additional modifications and augmentations to your ship!

Discover over 115 weapon and ship augments to create game-breaking synergies and redefine your strategy each expedition!

Transform your hull with augments like Pulsing Plating, enabling your ship to release a forceful burst of energy when sustaining damage, or deploy Proximity Mines to eliminate pursuing fighters.

Enhance your combat prowess with Smart Rounds, ammunition that ricochets between targets, or Nuclear Warheads, radioactive payloads that leave a damaging, lingering cloud in their wake!

Your Starmap is a web of opportunity and peril. Choose your path through hazardous sectors and encounter space stations in need of reinforcements, inhabited planets under siege from The Observers, and derelict ships with priceless data in need of salvaging.

Completing these missions, as well as random secondary objectives, will earn you rewards crucial to your survival: weaponry, augmentations, credits, and even crew members!

Finding a merchant can allow you to spend your credits on upgrades and much-needed repairs. Responding to a distress beacon may lead you to become the savior of a group of stranded scientists—or place you at the mercy of something far worse!

Death is not the end. Battlefield wreckage, recovered data, and alien technologies salvaged from your failed expeditions can be exchanged for powerful, permanent upgrades to your arsenal! Unlock fleet-wide stat boosts, new ships with unique combat specializations, additional crew members, and ship customizations!

Early Development Disclaimer

Starforged Legacy is currently in early development. The features we currently have and those planned for the future may change as we gather feedback from our community. You can expect to see these changes reflected here as they occur.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400/AMD Ryzen 3 1300X or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400/AMD Ryzen 5 5600 or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.

short_description: Outlast the onslaught in a sci-fi survivors-like where your decisions matter as much as your firepower. Command customizable starships, enhance your arsenal with 115+ strategy-defining augments, and annihilate endless fleets of cosmic combatants! Carve your legacy among the stars and die trying!
